figurative_meaning_en: Nothing; to be left empty-handed or idle
example_sentences_in_bangla: সবাই কিছু-না-কিছু নিয়ে গেল, তুমি বসে বুড়ো আঙুল চোষো না।
পরীক্ষায় সবাই ভালো করল, সে বুড়ো আঙুল চোষছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone took something, don't just sit there sucking your thumb.
Everyone did well in the exam, but he's just twiddling his thumbs.
note: The idiom implies inaction or being deprived while others benefit, rooted in everyday Bengali expressions of frustration.
